text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — PD#INC-9876 —  auth-service (token-signing) high error rate detected

pagerduty: Trigger: auth-service.token_signing.errors > 5% for 2m — Escalation policy: oncall-auth -> infra-sre

sara.oncall: ack — I'm on it. seeing 502s and 401s in prod since 02:47 UTC. marking Sev-2 for now.

devon-m: grabbing logs. looks like JWT validation fails with 'kid not found' on production JWKS lookup.

ops-bot: recent deploy: auth-service@2026.03.14-2315 rolled 02:41 UTC (git sha: a7f3d2f).

natalie-s: timeline — customers started reporting errors ~02:46 UTC (support ingest). Is there a known key rotation?

devon-m: nope, no scheduled key rotation. checking external KMS and the JWKS endpoint.

infra-tilt: logs snippet from auth-service (filtered):
```
2026-03-14T02:46:23Z ERROR validation: jwt: kid "rk_2026_03" not found in JWKS
2026-03-14T02:46:23Z WARN token: fallback signing key expired
2026-03-14T02:46:24Z ERROR http: /v1/generate -> 502 upstream validation error
```

sara.oncall: estimate impact: 12% of token validation requests failing across US-west, US-east. Some customers hitting retries time out.

customer-ops: flagged 3 enterprise customers experiencing session failures; one reported partial data loss on sync attempts. notifying CS.

devon-m: JWKS endpoint (https://auth.redwood-inference/api/.well-known/jwks.json) currently returns keys array missing the active kid. curl output:
```
$ curl -s https://auth.redwood-inference/api/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys | map(.kid)'
["rk_2025_main","rk_backup"]
```

devon-m: that explains it — service is trying to validate tokens signed by a newer key (rk_2026_03) that never propagated to JWKS. gotta check signing-service logs.

sara.oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) fallback to allow unsigned token validation for a short window (risky), 2) force auth-service to use backup signing key that matches JWKS (safer), 3) push missing key to JWKS (if available in KMS). preferences?

natalie-s: option 3 is ideal — add the missing public key to JWKS. do we have the public material in KMS or on the key-management service?

devon-m: checking KMS entries: found private key metadata for rk_2026_03 but the public export job failed due to permission error at 02:40 UTC. Looks like deploy changed the key exporter IAM role.

ops-bot: KMS event: export_public_key failed for rk_2026_03 — permission_denied -> role: key-exporter-service-account.

sara.oncall: OK, short-term plan: roll auth-service to use rk_backup key (which is already in JWKS) to restore validation while we fix exporter. rolling with canary 10% then 100% if green.

devon-m: command to roll (prod namespace):
```
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/auth-service SIGNING_KEY_ID=rk_backup --record
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/auth-service
```

sara.oncall: starting canary now. @infra-tilt monitor error rate and latency.

infra-tilt: canary rolled to 10% at 02:52 UTC. metrics: token validation errors dropped from 12% -> 2.1% within 30s. no increase in latency.

sara.oncall: pushing to 100% in 2m if stable. notifying PD to suspend further escalations.

pagerduty: Acknowledgement updated: incident assigned to sara.oncall, status: acknowledged -> maintenance mode suggested.

natalie-s: once stable, we'll open a follow-up to restore rk_2026_03 properly — need to fix key-exporter IAM role and re-run public export. also rotate any tokens signed only with rk_2026_03 after verification.

devon-m: 100% roll complete 02:56 UTC. validation errors back down to 0.4%. CS update draft: "Auth token validation errors observed between 02:46-02:56 UTC; most traffic restored after fallback to backup signing key. Working on permanent fix and will follow up."

customer-ops: sending targeted messages to affected customers now.

ops-bot: created follow-up ticket: INF-5402 "restore rk_2026_03 to JWKS + IAM fix" assigned to infra-sre.

sara.oncall: postmortem notes to collect: root cause, why exporter lost permissions during deploy, timeline, number of affected users, mitigation steps, and post-incident action items (IAM test in deploy pipeline, automated JWKS reconciliation, and alert on KMS export failures).

devon-m: quick checklist for cleanup: 1) verify rk_2026_03 private key integrity in KMS, 2) fix key-exporter role, 3) re-run export and validate jwks contains rk_2026_03, 4) optionally roll services back to rk_2026_03 if we want newer key live.

natalie-s: assigning incident lead for postmortem: sara.oncall. target completed postmortem draft in 48h.

sara.oncall: thanks all. closing PD escalation now. will keep thread updated as infra-sre works INF-5402. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: Incident INC-9876 status: resolved (72m).

incident-bot: follow-up reminders set: postmortem due 2026-03-16 02:52 UTC.

sara.oncall: adding final note — if anyone sees token errors reappear ping this thread and page infra-sre directly.

devon-m: leaving logs + runbook snippet in ops-runbooks/auth-token-issues.md -> added steps for canary rollback and JWKS quick-fix.

customer-ops: CS follow-up sent to affected customers; one requested post-incident call, scheduled for 2026-03-15 15:00 UTC.

sara.oncall: end of thread.
